evidence.notes: SOSL Search.query accepts WITH HIGHLIGHT and returns deterministic fixed local search rows.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLWithHighlightTest { @isTest static void acceptsWithHighlightSearchOption() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Highlighted Account'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); List<Account> rows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {Highlighted} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH HIGHLIGHT')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(account.Id, rows[0].Id); } }
